name: Freeze Tag
hook: Get tagged, freeze. Touch a friend to thaw them.
how: Taggers freeze every runner they touch. Frozen runners wait in a block of ice until a free teammate stands next to them for a second. If anyone is still free when the clock runs out, the runners win; freeze them all and the taggers do.
controls: WASD or hold the mouse to run, Space to dash, or the touch stick and Dash button
uses: The host's browser picks the taggers, decides every freeze and thaw and keeps the score; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot taggers chase and bot runners flee and thaw their friends until enough people join.
Every runner, tagger and ice block is the same for everyone.
The most points anyone scored in one round.
ideas: Make it a snowball fight in a winter park
Add a power-up that makes you invisible for 3 seconds
Let the last runner standing get a golden crown
